base_template: Write a real-time monitoring alert describing network instability in the {{location}} area. Explain that a rogue device has claimed to be the Spanning Tree Root with priority {{priority}}, affecting VLAN {{vlan_id}}. Describe the impact on network traffic.

location.instruction: Generate a room or office name (e.g. Server Room A, Floor 3 East Wing)

vlan_id.instruction: Generate a random VLAN ID between 10 and 100 (integer)

priority.instruction: Generate an STP priority lower than 32768, e.g. 0 or 4096

expected_solution: Enable BPDU Guard on access ports (Gi0/1, Gi0/2) and Root Guard on the uplink port (Gi0/0) of CiscoIOSvL2-1.
